sentences.text: Aristocracy -LRB- Greek ἀριστοκρατία aristokratía , from ἄριστος aristos `` excellent , '' and κράτος kratos `` power '' -RRB- is a form of government that places power in the hands of a small , privileged ruling class .	Greek	Greek language	power	Power (social and political)	form of government	form of government	ruling class	ruling class
The term derives from the Greek aristokratia , meaning `` rule of the best '' .	Greek	Greek language

At the time of the word 's origins in Ancient Greece , the Greeks conceived it as rule by the best qualified citizens -- and often contrasted it favourably with monarchy , rule by an individual .	Ancient Greece	Ancient Greece	monarchy	monarchy
In later times , aristocracy was usually seen as rule by a privileged group , the aristocratic class , and was contrasted with democracy .	aristocratic class	Aristocracy (class)	democracy	democracy
